title: Rocket Holder & Lathe Rocket Part
description: Turned stepped rocket shafts (G71/G70) on the Fanuc lathe and machined a dedicated custom rocket holder on the VMC milling machine.

title: Milling Machine Smiley & Letters
description: Programmed quadrant offsets (G158/G54) on the milling machine to engrave custom letters and smiley faces directly into metal stock.

title: The Staircase Nut (CAD & 3D Print)
description: Modeled replacement nuts on a smartphone in Onshape with internal helix threads, 3D printed them, and verified a snug physical fit on the toy staircase.

title: Kali in PRoot Termux (Android)
description: Deployed a full Kali Linux environment on an unrooted Android smartphone to audit vulnerabilities, inspect network packets, and test web applications.

title: Parametric Internal Threads
description: Swept profile helical cuts with exact Pierce geometric constraints in Onshape, ready for high-tolerance CNC tapping or 3D printing.

title: Mini Python Tasks & PDF Tools
description: Custom automated Python scripts to extract, reorganize, merge, and edit targeted pages from complex legal and technical PDF documents.
